That gives I1 = f/Rs, independent of Vth. Gain is about RL/(Rs+1/gm). f3 = 1/(2*pi*RL*CL) is about 660 MHz. Power is about 2.0 mA from VDD (~4 mW at 1.98 V). Vout = VDD - I1*RL, roughly 0.8 to 1.16 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "I1":    (1.95e-3, 1.4e-3, 2.3e-3),   # main CS current (sets vout_dc = VDD - I1*R)
    "R":     (420.0, 350.0, 480.0),       # load resistor -> f3db
    "Rs":    (130.0, 90.0, 200.0),        # degeneration -> gain ~ R/(Rs+1/gm), s = I1*Rs
    "gmid1": (10.0, 7.0, 15.0),           # M1 / replica Ms inversion level
    "L1":    (0.18, 0.15, 0.4),           # M1 / Ms length (DIBL matching vs input cap)
    "Ib":    (50e-6, 20e-6, 150e-6),      # replica diode current
    "Irf":   (0.5e-3, 0.2e-3, 1.5e-3),    # current through level-shift resistor Rf (supplied by vin)
    "Cb":    (2e-12, 0.5e-12, 5e-12),     # HF bypass caps vin->e, vin->f
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8

    I1, R, Rs, gmid1, L1 = p["I1"], p["R"], p["Rs"], p["gmid1"], p["L1"]
    Ib, Irf, Cb = p["Ib"], p["Irf"], p["Cb"]

    # replica level shift: f = vin - Irf*Rf ; e = f + VGS_s ; s = e - VGS_1 = f when densities match
    s_target = I1 * Rs
    s_target = min(s_target, vin - 0.15)
    Rf = (vin - s_target) / Irf
    Ik = Irf + Ib                      # sink at node f

    # replica diode Ms and main device M1 at identical current density and Vsb
    ms = lut.size("n", gmid1, L1, Ib, vds=0.7, vsb=s_target)
    W1 = ms.W * I1 / Ib
    m1 = lut.size("n", gmid1, L1, I1, vds=0.6, vsb=s_target)   # for predictions

    # bias mirrors (long L, ratioed W from reference op)
    Ib2 = iref
    mr = lut.size("n", 15, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    wn = mr.W / iref
    mp = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, Ib2, vds=1.0)
    wp = mp.W / Ib2

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    # NMOS reference + mirrors
    n.M("Mr", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wn * iref, 1.0)
    n.M("Mk", "f", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wn * Ik, 1.0)
    n.M("Mb", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wn * Ib2, 1.0)
    # PMOS mirror sourcing Ib into replica node e
    n.M("Mp1", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", wp * Ib2, 1.0)
    n.M("Mp2", "e", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", wp * Ib, 1.0)
    # level shifter
    n.R("Rf", "vin", "f", Rf)
    n.C("Cf", "vin", "f", Cb)
    n.M("Ms", "e", "e", "f", "vss", "nfet", ms.W, L1)
    n.C("Ce", "vin", "e", Cb)
    # gain stage
    n.M("M1", "vout", "e", "s", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)
    n.R("Rs", "s", "vss", Rs)
    n.R("RL", "vdd", "vout", R)

    # predictions
    gm, gmb = m1.gm, m1.gmbs
    Gm = 1.0 / (1.0 / gm + Rs * (1.0 + gmb / gm))
    gain = Gm * R
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m1.cgd
    f3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * R * cout)
    gbw = gain * f3
    power = vdd * (I1 + Ib + Ib2 + iref)
    vout_dc = vdd - I1 * R
    up = min(vdd - 0.15 - vout_dc, 0.85 * 0.3 * gain)
    down = vout_dc - (s_target + m1.vdsat + 0.05)
    swing = max(up, 0) + max(down, 0)

    return n, {"gain_db": db(gain), "f3db": f3, "gbw": gbw, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_dc, "swing": swing}
